analysis: Covariate coverage on fitting samples and all ranking departures; correlations with raw offset residual centered within airport and NM-availability group. This is not a v6 model error or a development RMSE.
availability: The original supplied ranking arrivals retain taxi-in labels and block timestamps. Use only arrival rows completed strictly before each query, with completion=max(landing, in-block). Exclude every focal flight ID. No departure label or departure block time enters any context aggregate. Official pages describe a post-operations task; there is no online publication-time claim.
departure_label_scope: At most 10,000 deterministic, evenly spaced movement IDs per airport plus all missing-clock departures in the intersection of the two original fitting sets. No original scoring/stopping departure labels, December labels, or hidden ranking departure labels.
normal_arrival_interval: 0 through 10800 seconds inclusive for a separately flagged mean; raw moments and anomaly fractions remain separate. No departure target or model prediction is clipped.
purpose: Fitting-only assessment of previously unused, supplied arrival taxi-in context. This does not add a timeline candidate or fit a model.
selection: No model selection or promotion. A future experiment needs a separate declaration.
